title: HCRIS layer: Medicare hospital cost reports (Form CMS-2552-10), one HCRIS year
description: One row per acute or critical access hospital that filed a cost report beginning in the year (CMS's 'cost reports beginning in FY<YYYY>'), as an array in `columns` order: identity, how its reports were combined (`shape`, `basis`), CMS's status codes and the reader label ('as filed' or 'settled'), the period the values cover, then the cells (worksheet, line and column in pp_engine/hcris/cells.py) and the derived ratios. A null value is a cell HCRIS doesn't store: zero or not reported. Money is dollars as filed; ratios are fractions to 4 places.

fy.description: The HCRIS year: the federal fiscal year the cost reporting periods begin in (the 2552-10 form's first full year is FY2011; common.schema.json's fy starts at 2013).

periodsBegin.description: The first and last days a period in this file can begin.

posted.description: CMS's Last-Modified date for the zip the pin was derived from (the posting).

filingDueBy.description: The last due date of a regular 12-month report in the year (42 CFR 413.24(f)(2)(i)); extensions aside.

stillFiling.description: The posting is on or before filingDueBy: CMS is still receiving this year's reports, so hospitals are missing.

longRule.description: How a hospital with reports covering more than a year is read: the fullest report alone.

early.description: settledShare < earlyBelow: S-10 (uncompensated-care) figures for the year are early and move most at settlement.

row.description: 61 values in `columns` order (the emitter checks the length and that each CCN appears once). Units by column are pp_engine.hcris.cells.UNITS.
